# Using This Book with the IoT@UCI Kit {.unnumbered}

Most chapters include a **Try it on your kit** box. These exercises assume the IoT@UCI team kit: an ESP32 DevKit V1 on two 830-point breadboards, with a set of sensors, actuators, a display, a secure element and a LoRa radio.

## What is in the kit

| Part | Role | Bus | Used from |
|---|---|---|---|
| ESP32 DevKit V1 | Microcontroller with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth | — | @sec-ch02 |
| LEDs, push buttons, potentiometer, buzzer | Basic I/O | GPIO / ADC / PWM | @sec-ch03 |
| 128×64 OLED display (SSD1306) | Text and graphics output | SPI | @sec-ch05 |
| BMP280 | Temperature and pressure sensor | I²C | @sec-ch05 |
| MPU-6050 | Accelerometer and gyroscope | I²C | @sec-ch05 |
| ATECC608A | Secure element (device identity, signatures) | I²C | @sec-ch05, @sec-ch15 |
| Servo motor | Actuator on its own 5 V rail | PWM | @sec-ch07 |
| RFM95W (SX1276) | LoRa radio | SPI | @sec-ch10 |

The kit is built in stages, so that each part is wired just before the chapter that first needs it. The full build is described in [Lab 1](/part7-lab-companion/L1-build-the-kit.qmd), and the complete pin map is in @sec-app-a.

## How each chapter is organized

Every chapter follows the same pattern, so you can choose how deep to go:

| Element | What it is | Required? |
|---|---|---|
| **Concepts** | The core ideas, with diagrams | Yes |
| **Try it on your kit** | Short exercises on the kit | Recommended |
| **In depth (optional)** | The math, physics and technical detail behind the chapter: formulas, worked examples and an exercise | No: clearly marked and skippable |
| **Advanced track** | Extra tasks for graduate students and those who want more | No |
| **Check your understanding** | Review questions | Recommended |

: Chapter elements.

Part VII (the Lab Companion) and Part VIII (the Lecture Activities) turn the chapters into step-by-step handouts.

## Safety

Always unplug the USB cable before changing any wiring. Never connect the servo's 5 V rail to the 3.3 V rail. Read [Lab 0](/part7-lab-companion/L0-bench-safety-soldering.qmd) before you solder.
